message:
Let me look for fonts with kerx tables. Let me check which test fonts have kerx tables.

<｜｜DSML｜｜execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/harfbuzz/test/shaping/data/in-house/fonts && for f in *.ttf; do if python3 -c "
import struct, sys
data = open('$f','rb').read()
# Find kerx table
if b'kerx' in data:
    print('$f has kerx')
" 2>/dev/null; then :; fi; done 2>/dev/null | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜execute_bash>
